newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian town logs 13 murders in one night.
newsitem.headline: Colombian town logs 13 murders in one night.

text.p: Thirteen people were killed overnight in a town near Medellin, Colombia's second-largest city, police sources said on Sunday.
They said a group of unidentified gunmen shot six men and one woman to death in a red-light district east of the city on Saturday night.
The seven were killed in attacks on two houses half a block apart in the town of La Ceja, 25 miles (40 km) from Medellin, capital of northwestern Antioquia province, the sources said.
As many as 12 people armed with 9 mm pistols were said to have taken part in the shootings, which police said might have been linked to drugs.
In a neighbourhood close to the red-light area, two more men were killed, and the bodies of four others were found in countryside close to the town.
Police have yet to determine whether the six victims died late on Saturday or early on Sunday.
